sources: Delivery Guaranteed ("Pursuit" in docs/kit-batches/batch-1/chr_0013_aglina.md). rmxlinux Json/SkillData sk_wpn_funnel_0011: passiveEventActions (abilityEvent 30, CheckSkillType [6]) create buff_wpn_funnel_0011 at the wielder's combo cast. BuffData buff_wpn_funnel_0011 (maxTriggerCnt 1: once per combo cast) on abilityEvent 402 checks CheckPhysicalInflictionType mask 1 (Lift) and CheckOriginSkillType [6] (the causing hit is a combo's), counts the targets (≤ max_stack 3), computes spell_dmg_up + count × spell_dmg_up2 (SimpleCalcBBAction) and creates buff_wpn_funnel_0011_valid on the whole team (CharacterTeamFinder, wielder included): attributes 51–54 (Heat/Electric/Cryo/Nature DMG) formulaItem 5, `duration` 15 s, stackingType 1 priority spell_dmg_up (two wielders don't add up). Values from SkillPatchTable sk_wpn_funnel_0011 at the weapon's skill-3 level.

Order: before the lifting hit's damage. fixtures/zmdlogs-4e5e1390085e.json: the combo hits at 7598, 30327 and 55403 ms carry buff_wpn_funnel_0011_valid as a boundary buff and match only with it applied (0.248 = 0.192 + 1 × 0.056 at skill level 4). The buff then lasts its 15 s (7598 to about 23.7 s), through later basic attacks, although its CreateBuff says finishWithNextSkillIfNotInherited.

The weapon's Nature DMG + (cardAttributeModifier attr 54, nature_dmg_up) is in the stat panel. Its toggleBuffs buff_wpn_lance_0003 (CheckCurHpRatio, ATK%) is inert: neither key is in sk_wpn_funnel_0011's blackboard and no fixture logs it.

buffs.note: spell_dmg_up + min(targets, max_stack) × spell_dmg_up2; one enemy: 1 target.

triggers.note: "After the wielder's combo skill applies Lifted, the team gains Arts DMG Dealt +{spell_dmg_up} for {duration}s. For every enemy Lifted, ... +{spell_dmg_up2}". maxPerCast 1: the buff's maxTriggerCnt 1, one buff_wpn_funnel_0011 per combo cast.
